children: Overview
US community bank's Q3 net income attributable to common stockholders rose sequentially to $392,000
Diluted EPS for Q3 was $0.04, up from $0.02 in Q2 and a loss last yr
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for upcoming quarters or full year in its press release
Result Drivers

LOAN AND DEPOSIT GROWTH - Co said higher net interest income QoQ was driven by increases in average loan and securities balances, supported by 11.4% loan growth and 21% deposit growth in first nine months
HIGHER FUNDING COSTS - Net interest margin remained stable despite elevated funding costs from higher interest rates, according to management
NON-INTEREST INCOME DROP - Non-interest income fell from prior qtr due to absence of a one-time fee from a tax credit transaction
